name: Easy Dropbox Integration – Browse, Upload, View, Download & Manage Dropbox Files From Your WordPress Website
author: ultraDevs

sections.description:
Easy Dropbox Integration – Browse, Upload, View, Download & Manage Dropbox Files From Your WordPress Website. This plugin allows you to browse your Dropbox files and upload files to Dropbox from your WordPress website. You can also create a shortcode to show the Dropbox files on your website.

Video Overview

📚 Documentation | 🚀 Get PRO

🆓 Free Features

⚙️ Easy Setup
Just login with your Dropbox Account and start managing your Dropbox files from your WordPress website Easily!

⏫ File Uploader
Upload your files to your Dropbox account from your WordPress website.

📝 Shortcode Builder
Create a shortcode to show your Dropbox files on your WordPress website. It does have Document Embed, View Links, Download Links, File Uploader, Gallery etc.

👁️ Previewer
View your files in a preview popup.

🔀 Contact Form 7 Integration
Add Dropbox file uploader to your contact form 7 form. 🎬 Video

🧑‍💻 Premium Features

🔀 wooCommerce Downloadable Products Integration
Allow you to select your product’s Downloadable files from Dropbox, Uploading files on checkout coming soon InshAllah. 🎬 Watch Video

⏯️ Media Library Integration
Connect your media library with your Dropbox account from your WordPress website.

Popular Plugins Integration (Modules)

🔀 Gutenberg Block Editor Integration
Connect your Gutenberg Block Editor with your Dropbox account from your WordPress website using Custom Gutenberg Block.

🔀 Elementor Page Builder Integration
Connect your Elementor Page Builder with your Dropbox account from your WordPress website using Custom Elementor Widgets.

🔀 Divi Page Builder Integration (Upcoming)
Connect your Divi Page Builder with your Dropbox account from your WordPress website using Custom Divi Modules.

🔀 WooCommerce Integration
Sell Downloadable Products on your WordPress website from your Dropbox account.

📤 Seamless Form Builder Integration
Effortlessly connect the plugin with popular form builders like Contact Form 7 and Elementor Pro Forms to collect files directly from your visitors and save them to your Dropbox account.

🪄 Upcoming Features

🔒 User Private Files
Upload your private files to your Dropbox account from your WordPress website.

🔍 File Search
Search your Dropbox files from your WordPress website.

🛠️ Shortcode Builder Upgrades
We will add File Browser, File Search, Slider etc soon InshAllah.

🔗 Popular Plugins Integration (Modules)
We have only wooCommerce Downloadable Product’s integration in this plugin. We will be working to add more popular plugins in this plugin soon, InshAllah.

External Libraries and Links Used

We use the following external libraries and links in this plugin
– Dropbox PHP SDK – To browse and upload files from Dropbox
– lightGallery – To show images/videos/pdf and other files in a popup preview
– Flaticon – For Icons.

Links:
https://docs.google.com/viewerng/viewer?embedded=true&url= – To view PDF files in the popup preview.
https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src= – To view Office files in the popup preview.

🎯 Basic Usage

👉 Link a Dropbox Account
After installing and activating the plugin, login with your Dropbox account and start managing your Dropbox files from your WordPress website. You can link multiple Dropbox accounts in PRO version.

👉 ShortCode Builder
Create a shortcode to show your Dropbox files on your WordPress website. It does have Document Embed, View Links, Download Links, File Uploader, Gallery etc.

Data Privacy

The Application collects the following information when you use the built-in app for authentication and link the Application with your Dropbox account:

  1. Your WordPress website address.
  2. A short-lived authorization code generated by the OAuth flow.

This information is obtained and used only after you grant the Application the requested access via the Dropbox OAuth consent screen. Once you provide consent, you will be redirected to the server of ultradevs.com (https://oauth.ultradevs.com/dropbox-integrator-wp.php), which will redirect you back to your own site where the authorization process is finalized. This redirect through ultradevs.com ensures a smooth plugin setup without requiring you to create your own Dropbox App, allowing you to use your own Authorized Redirect URI.

ultraDevs Privacy Policy

ℹ️ IMPORTANT: When using the Application, all communications occur strictly between your server and Dropbox’s servers. All communication is encrypted, and no data passes through our servers. We do not collect or access your files.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/easy-dropbox-integration directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
